name: Witch Hunter ~Choroi ze Mahou Shoujo~
original_name: ウィッチハンター ～ちょろいぜ魔法少女～
source:
In this world, there are "Magical Girls". All day long, the exploits of magical girls are reported on the news.

The protagonist goes to work as usual, does his job, and goes home. Days go by unchanged. But one day, the protagonist's ordinary life is interrupted when the company he works for suddenly goes bankrupt.

He understands it in his head... he tries to process it... but somewhere inside, he can't accept it. His frustration keeps piling up day by day, and before he knows it, his dissatisfaction is aimed at society.

"Why am I the only one who has to go through this?"
"Isn't it unfair that some people are helped by magical girls... but I'm in this situation?"
"I wish this society would just... just die!"

Before he knows it, negative emotions take over his mind.

At such a time, a female executive of an evil organization notices the protagonist's negative aura and sees talent in him. She approaches the protagonist to invite him to join.

However, this executive turns out to be utterly incompetent. And so, the protagonist finds himself embroiled in the executive's clumsy schemes.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1337050]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
这个世界上，存在着“魔法少女”。新闻里整天都在报道魔法少女的事迹。

主角像往常一样去上班，做完自己的工作，然后回家。日子一天天过去，一成不变。但有一天，主人公工作的公司突然破产，他的正常生活被打乱了。

他在脑子里明白了这一点……他试图处理它……但在内心的某个地方，他无法接受它。他的挫败感与日俱增，不知不觉间，他的不满就指向了社会。

“为什么只有我一个人要经历这些？”
“有些人得到魔法少女的帮助，这不是不公平吗……而我却是这种情况？”
“我希望这个社会……死掉！”

在他意识到之前，负面情绪占据了他的思想。

这时，邪恶组织的女高管注意到了主角身上的负面光环，并看到了他的才华。她走近主角邀请他加入。

然而，事实证明这位高管完全无能。于是，主角发现自己被卷入了高管的笨拙计划中。

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1337050]Getchu[/url]]
